map.编码冗余度计算器。比较平均码长与信源信息熵，按 (平均码长−熵)/熵 评估编码冗: Coding redundancy calculator. Compares average code length with source information entropy, evaluating coding redundancy by (average code length - entropy)/entropy; lower redundancy means better coding, suitable for efficiency analysis and optimization of communication coding schemes.
map.冗余 = (平均码长 − 熵) / 平均码长: Redundancy = (average code length - entropy) / average code length
map.信源编码优化：评估哈夫曼/算术编码相对熵的冗余，指导压缩方案。: Source coding optimization: evaluate Huffman/arithmetic coding redundancy relative to entropy to guide compression schemes.
map.信道效率分析：比较不同变长码的平均码长与理论下限。: Channel efficiency analysis: compare average code length of different variable-length codes with the theoretical lower bound.
map.教学演示：展示定长码在符号概率不均时的冗余浪费。: Teaching demo: show redundancy waste of fixed-length codes when symbol probabilities are uneven.
map.：熵≈0.469 bit，若定长 1 bit/符号则冗余≈113%；哈夫曼可逼近: : Entropy ≈ 0.469 bit; if fixed 1 bit/symbol, redundancy ≈ 113%; Huffman can approach entropy, redundancy near 0.
map.冗余度为何不是越低越好？: Why is lower redundancy not always better?
map.为纠错常主动加冗余（如信道编码），效率与可靠性需权衡。: For error correction, redundancy is often added intentionally (e.g., channel coding); efficiency and reliability must be balanced.
map.信源编码冗余越低压缩越强；本指标衡量离香农下限的差距。: Lower source-coding redundancy means stronger compression; this metric measures the gap from the Shannon limit.
map.H=−Σ p_i·log2(p_i)，见信息熵（香农）工具。: H = -Σ p_i·log2(p_i); see the information entropy (Shannon) tool.
